context: The power law exponent n is determined from doublelogarithmic plots of secondary creep strain rate vs. stress, as shown in Fig. 9. For the woven Ni-20Cr-3Ti-2Al superalloy, n is 6.3 at 825°C , which is identical to that for the bulk Ni-20Cr-3Ti-2Al superalloy n=6.3 ) shown in Fig. 1. It is apparent from Fig. 9 that, for a given stress, the creep strain rate for the woven Ni-based superalloy is higher by a factor of ∼3.7 than that for the bulk superalloy due to the lower solid volume fraction of the woven structure, while the creep exponents are identical to both cases.
